round1EvidenceContents: River Pavilion is fully set up, confirmed dry and free of flooding, with staff onsite, stocked kitchens, and tested technical equipment.
The access road to Mountain Lodge was completely blocked by fallen trees at 8am, and campus maintenance does not expect it to be cleared today.
The roof leak at Garden Hall is only over the storage closet; the main hall is confirmed dry and ready.

River Pavilion is fully set up, and security has confirmed it is dry and free of flooding. Pavilion staff are onsite, kitchens are stocked, and all technical equipment has been tested as working post-storm.
A Pavilion staff member disclosed privately that mold was discovered under the kitchen sink during setup; he worries it could affect food safety if it gets stirred up during cooking.
Garden Hall has a small roof leak reported overnight, but staff have placed buckets to catch any water. The main hall was not inspected this morning because staff prioritized the Pavilion and Lodge.
Mountain Lodge is on high ground and has backup power. However, heavy snow has been falling since last night, and it's uncertain whether the road will stay open.
